briefings.title: Dan Loeb: The Lost Art of Short Selling, and Why Stock Picking is Back
briefings.tldr: Dan Loeb, CEO and CIO of Third Point, outlines his evolution from an early internet activist investor to managing a $30 billion multi-strategy platform, emphasizing the return of disciplined short selling, the transition toward quality- and AI-driven investing, and his successful philanthropic campaign to secure the presidential pardon of Silk Road founder Ross Ulbricht.

briefings.title: 30 Years of Finding Alpha | Dan Loeb
briefings.tldr: Over his 30-year career, Third Point founder Dan Loeb has transitioned from a deep-value, event-driven credit investor into a multi-asset capital allocator, emphasizing that modern investors must understand technology, prioritize corporate governance, and exploit market structure anomalies to generate consistent alpha.
